title: erodium gruinum var. cuneatum
intro: Erodium gruinum var. cuneatum, commonly known as the narrow-leaved heron's bill, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Erodium gruinum var. cuneatum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
